Fix applied to both TS7053 sites (lines 216 and 573).

**Root cause:** `(govResult as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).choices` has type `unknown`. The `?.` narrows `unknown` to `{}` (removing null/undefined), and `{}` has no index signature — so `[0]` is an implicit `any` index. The double cast threw away the real type for no benefit.

**Fix:** use the actual typed shape. `governedGenerate` returns `GovernedGenerateResult` (`server/governance/governed-generate.ts:111`), which carries `rawResult?: InvokeResult`, and `InvokeResult.choices` (`server/_core/llm.ts:102`) is exactly `Array<{ message: { content: string | Array<TextContent|ImageContent|FileContent> } }>` — the shape the original code was reaching for. So `govResult.rawResult?.choices[0]?.message.content` types cleanly as `string | Array<...> | undefined`, and the existing `typeof rawAdvice === 'string'` guard already narrows it to `string`. No casts, no suppressions, no deleted logic; the optional `rawResult` preserves the same fallback path when the raw LLM result is absent (e.g. degraded mode).

Also dropped the now-redundant `return advice as string` since `advice` is already `string`.

**One thing I could not do:** every form of the verification command (`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`, `npm run check`, `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc ...`) and the serena LSP diagnostics tool were denied by the permission layer, so I have not empirically confirmed a zero-error result. The reasoning above is from reading the type declarations directly. If you approve one typecheck run I'll confirm and fix anything remaining.

Two notes worth flagging, both out of scope and untouched:
- This is a latent runtime bug, not just a typing one — `govResult.choices` was always `undefined` at runtime, so `generatePreventionAdvice` has been persisting `'Unable to generate advice.'` into `suggestedPrevention`, and `evaluatePersonaAlignment` has been parsing `'{}'`. Going through `rawResult` makes it read the real response. If you'd prefer these to read the post-governance text instead, `govResult.content` is the field for that — say the word and I'll switch both.
- The identical broken cast exists at `server/services/auto-rewrite-pipeline.ts:414` and `server/services/document-governance.ts:275`. I left them alone since the task scoped to one file, but they likely carry the same two errors each.
